name: Link
purpose: Makes a few words of a line a link, such as a GOV.UK page named in one of GOV.UK Chat's answers.

origin.notes: How GOV.UK Chat draws a link in an answer (ChatMarkdownTheme) and in its list of sources: text.linkSecondary, underlined. It takes the size and weight of the line around it.

href.description: Where it goes, such as a GOV.UK page.

inputs.content: The words that are the link. Put it inside a <govuk-app-text> or a <govuk-app-bulleted-list-item>, around the words, and it takes that text's size.

events.name: click
events.description: From the link it draws, when it's pressed, before it goes to its href.

rules: Make the link's words say where it goes, such as the page's title, not click here.
Use it inside a line of text. For a link on a row of its own, use a grouped list's link row, or a link card for one that should stand out.

avoid.when: For a link on a row of its own
For one destination that should stand out, such as the user's council
For an action, such as continuing a journey

examples.name: In a sentence
examples.html: <govuk-app-text>You can <govuk-app-link href="https://www.gov.uk/apply-renew-passport">apply for or renew your passport online</govuk-app-link>.</govuk-app-text>
